source: Highrise item catalogue + Creature Club gift log

releases.name: LAND Sale Owner Rewards (2022)
releases.note: Buying LAND in the 2022 sale paid you out in items, and how much LAND you bought decided which ones. Premium LAND took the Legendary tier and a Premium Egg; standard LAND took the Epic tier and a Standard Egg. The pieces carried boosts for the Lucky Token Blitz that ran alongside the sale, which is why LAND owners climbed that reward ladder faster. Highrise ran all of it, not the club, and the pets that hatched from those eggs were never NFTs.

releases.name: Land Ho Lucky Token Blitz (2022)
releases.note: Highrise ran this one, not the club. Every LAND you owned handed you an item that carried a boost, so the more LAND you held the further up the reward ladder you climbed. The Set Sail grab was paid for in Lucky Tokens, a smaller slime grab ran beside it, and crews were ranked first to tenth for the trophies. None of it is a Creature Club asset, though. Tom made the pieces and LAND bought you the boosts, but the pet egg and the Slimekitty inside it were never NFTs and were never part of the club's own line. It's indexed here because it's part of the story, not because it's ours.

releases.name: Land Ho! Furniture Collection (2022)
releases.note: Highrise sold these alongside the 2022 LAND sale, as a straight shop collection rather than a club release. The mini houses came in three colours across four sizes, with a premium tier on top, and the flags and harbour pieces filled out the set. Nothing here is a Creature Club asset.

releases.name: Creature Club Tee Series (2022)
releases.note: These didn't all go out the same way. Tom sent Tee #1 by hand to a few helpers, and made Tee #2 for Creature World to hand out at their parties. The rest were airdropped, which is why those two are the scarcest things here at 78 and 61 made, whatever their rarity tier says.

releases.name: HCC Halloween 2022 Room Design Contest
releases.note: The prize for this one was a Chilling Egg and the Vampkin that hatched out of it, which the winner named Creature. Both the egg and the pet come from Highrise's own Halloween 2022 pet line rather than the club's, and neither was ever an NFT. They're here because the contest was ours.
